description.value: Final Approach Restaurant is a casual dine-in spot situated beside the Qualicum Beach Airport, offering the novelty of watching aircraft while enjoying a meal. The kitchen is best known for its fish 'n' chips — available in cod, salmon, or halibut — alongside a broad menu of salads, tacos, flatbreads, and burgers. A rotating specials board and weekend brunch service make it a versatile stop for cyclists passing through the Parksville-Qualicum corridor.

address.value: 3-1000 Ravensbourne Lane, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1P9
